memory_retention_benchmark.value: recombinase memory reported to persist over many cell generations (~90+ often cited)
memory_retention_benchmark.source: Siuti, Yazbek & Lu 2013, Nat. Biotechnol. 31:448-452 (DOI-verified via CrossRef)
memory_retention_benchmark.provenance: CAVEAT: the specific '90 generations' figure was NOT confirmed from full text or abstract this session (closed access, abstract not retrievable). Recorded as a literature-reported order-of-magnitude target, not a session-verified measurement.
memory_retention_benchmark.role: consistency-check reference, NOT a quantitative validation datapoint

bxb1_expression_burden.value: no measurable metabolic burden from increased Bxb1 expression
bxb1_expression_burden.source: Gonzalez-Colell & Macia 2025, Sci. Rep. 15:31311 (10.1038/s41598-025-17024-y, full text read)
bxb1_expression_burden.provenance: Direct quote confirmed from fetched full text: recombinase expression 'did not impose a measurable metabolic burden on GFP expression in the control construct.'

reporter_expression_growth_tradeoff.value: approx linear; strong eGFP (>=0.07 mg/mg DCW) needed to depress growth to 0.59/h
reporter_expression_growth_tradeoff.source: Bienick, Young, Klesmith, Detwiler et al. 2014, PLoS ONE 9:e109105 (full text read)
reporter_expression_growth_tradeoff.provenance: Confirmed from fetched full text. Bounds a single moderate reporter's cost as small; does NOT yield a specific number for this construct.

fitness_cost_used.provenance: QUALITATIVE-INFORMED ESTIMATE, not derived from any paper. Chosen to be consistent with 'burden is small'; replaces the earlier arbitrary 0-10% sweep. Conclusion is robust across the whole range (see spec robustness check).
